name: typescript
description: 1. Define an interface User with the following properties:          id(number), name(string), email(string), age(number optional) 2. Create a class UserManager with:     A private array users: User[] to store user data.     A method addUser(user: User): void that adds a new user.     A method removeUser(id: number): void that removes a user by ID.     A method getUser(id: number): User | undefined that retrieves a user by ID.     A method getAllUsers(): User[] that returns all users. 3. Use Arrow Functions & Default Parameters         Add a method getUser = (name: string = "Guest"): string that returns a greeting message. 4. Use Destructuring & Spread Operator     Create a function printUserDetails(user: User): void that logs user details using object destructuring.
